title: AuthorRecordDecisionsParams
description:
`author.record_decisions` atomically records several supporting decisions
on one workspace branch.

records.description:
Decision records in durable append order. Empty batches are refused by
schema; duplicate ids are a typed, atomic validation finding.

workspace.description: The authoring workspace whose branch records the decisions.

AuthorDecisionRecord.description:
One decision record in an atomic [`AuthorRecordDecisionsParams`] batch.
The fields intentionally mirror [`AuthorRecordDecisionParams`] minus the
workspace: bulk recording changes commit granularity, not decision meaning.

decision.description: The caller-supplied decision id, matched by exact equality.

provenance.description: Optional citation-bearing provenance for the decision.

rationale.description:
Optional review rationale. It receives the same control-character guard
as the single operation and otherwise preserves that operation's current
metadata behaviour.

Provenance.description:
Provenance supplied when adding authored material. Internally tagged on
`kind`; origin tracking is load-bearing for the authoring seam (nothing an agent supplies
mints authority).

oneOf.description: Cited to one or more decisions: `{"kind":"cited","decisions":["D-0104"]}`.

decisions.description: The cited decision identifiers in the consuming repo's ledger.

state.description: The requested standing for the cited claim.

origin.description: The origin token of the proposal (e.g. an agent session id).

hyp.description: The hypothesis the material is conditioned on.

ProvenanceState.description:
The stored standing requested for a cited authoring operation.

Cited provenance requires this field at the request boundary.
